changes: The Floating Bar no longer steals keyboard focus or stays visible while snoozed when you work in another app
Choose multiple Google calendars to read and import while keeping new events on your primary calendar
Fixed agent runs that stall on a provider or silent subprocess hanging forever by stopping them at a configurable deadline
Fixed UI freezes while saving SD card recordings and duplicate audio accounting when stopping a download
Fixed Screen Capture turning itself back on after you switch it off
Updated the bundled macOS Node.js runtime to v22.23.5 to include the latest security fixes
Your AI user profile is now kept in your Omi account and updated automatically, so it stays the same on every device
Fixed silent conversation deletion failures and stale recording rows, with retry feedback when Omi is busy
